decision.summary: Two transient features in the screened region: (1) a sharp multi-axis shift at 608–612 with U dominant and correlated N/E changes, lacking observed return; (2) a later rebound-like U spike at 660–670 with divergent cross-axis behavior and no confirmed restoration of pre-event levels. Neither satisfies criteria for a confirmed temporary offset due to ambiguous or incomplete return within allowed context [570,729].

intervals.observation: U drops sharply (~10 MAD) at 608–612; N and E show smaller correlated transients (N down ~2, E up ~2). Return not observed within allowed context; rebound begins later (~660) but full recovery not confirmed before 729.

U rebounds sharply starting ~660; N/E show opposing small offsets during 660–670, but no clear return to pre-event baseline on any axis by 670. Interior behavior inconsistent with a clean temporary offset; coexisting motion or artifact likely.
